title: Ezekiel 4
paragraphs: ¹ "Now, son of man, take a clay tablet and place it in front of you and draw on it a city — Jerusalem. ² Lay siege to it: build siege works against it, heap up a ramp against it, set up camps against it, and position battering rams against it all around. ³ Then take an iron pan and set it up as an iron wall between you and the city. Turn your face toward it — it will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel. ⁴ Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the house of Israel on yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side. ⁵ I am giving you a day for each year, and you will bear the guilt of the house of Israel for three hundred and ninety days.

⁶ After you have done this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the guilt of the house of Judah for forty days — one day for each year. ⁷ Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm bared, and prophesy against her. ⁸ I will tie ropes around you so you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege. ⁹ Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt, and put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the three hundred and ninety days you lie on your side. ¹⁰ The food you eat each day will weigh about eight ounces; eat it at set times.

¹¹ Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times. ¹² Eat the food as you would eat barley bread; bake it in the sight of the people, using human dung as fuel." ¹³ The LORD said, "In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them." ¹⁴ Then I said, "Sovereign LORD, I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No impure meat has ever entered my mouth." ¹⁵ "Very well," he said, "I will let you bake your bread over cow dung instead of human dung."

¹⁶ He then said to me, "Son of man, I am about to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair, ¹⁷ for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.
